scope: Actual two-browser local split-origin race; before final server restart; early callback normalization applied in source afterward

notes: Application JSON and declared completed HTTP body bytes; excludes TLS/WS/HTTP headers, aborted partial bodies and provider accounting.

Browser metrics are untrusted aggregate samples from up to the last thirty minutes (report-count cap can shorten coverage), not unique people. Histogram p95 values are bucket upper bounds; the last bucket includes overflow.
History and totals reset on process restart. No persistence, external alerts, billing integration or cold-start measurement.
